settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Dunkirk 1940 wartime newsreel footage. Windy exposed beach, sea haze, smoke, wet sand, BEF uniforms, steel helmets, rifles, small rescue craft and period pier structures. Moderate film grain, gate weave, dust, fine scratches, frame flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic danger only. No modern objects, HDR, drones, gimbals, glossy cinematography or heroic staging.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Camera is operated by a physically present wartime correspondent standing, crouching, running and boarding among the soldiers. The operator remains 1-4 meters from friendly troops, cannot float above crowds or pre-position ahead of danger, reacts slightly late to aircraft and blasts, loses framing during sudden movement, is occluded by bodies and pier structures, and briefly refocuses after impacts. No spoken dialogue, narrator, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated 1940 field-camera realism on windblown sand and boats: uneven horizon, wind buffeting the camera, occasional sea spray or sand at lens edge, delayed pans to aircraft, cautious crouching in dunes, shoulder-height crowd framing, unstable footing on wet boards and natural boat sway.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional British infantryman anchors continuity while an unseen human cameraman shares the same beach, dunes, pier and boat journey.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute Dunkirk evacuation reenactment as if a human 1940 war correspondent were physically filming inside the evacuation line. The cameraman must obey wind, crowds, dunes, wet boards, boat motion and human reaction time. Follow exposed waiting, an air threat, a dash into dunes, return to the queue, the mole, boarding and looking back from the water. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel texture. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A British infantryman waits among long lines on Dunkirk beach. Aircraft pressure scatters the queue toward dunes, then the line reforms. He reaches the mole, survives another attack, boards a rescue craft and looks back at thousands still waiting while the human cameraman records the same ordeal from within the crowd.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP02 — Dunkirk 1940: Waiting on the Beach

scenes.title: Grey Shoreline
scenes.description: Long queues wait on an exposed beach.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman stands in line facing the sea.
scenes.imageDescription: Dunkirk 1940, long British queues, wet sand, smoke inland, distant boats, black-and-white 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman walks slowly beside the queue in soft sand at shoulder height; each step sinks and makes small vertical bumps. Nearby soldiers repeatedly cross the lens. Wind nudges the frame. Audio: surf, wind, boots, distant aircraft. No music or speech.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stops beside lead soldier still facing the sea.

scenes.title: Watching the Water
scenes.description: The soldier searches the sea for rescue craft.
scenes.actionDescription: He shields his eyes and scans offshore.
scenes.imageDescription: Same beach queue, smoke, sea haze, lead soldier looking offshore, monochrome newsreel.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stands just behind his shoulder and attempts a slow pan toward the sea; wind causes slight drift and a passing helmet briefly blocks the view. No perfect stabilized push. Audio: wind, surf, faint engines.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Frame ends on grey sea with queue still beside camera.

scenes.title: Aircraft Overhead
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman looks upward as the queue begins to break.
scenes.imageDescription: British troops looking skyward on open beach, smoke and windblown sand, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman reacts late to the engine sound: first catches men turning, then whips upward imperfectly, overshoots the aircraft, corrects, and drops back as bodies start moving. Audio: engines swelling, wind, gear.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator is caught among soldiers beginning to run toward dunes.

scenes.title: Run for the Dunes
scenes.description: The exposed queue scatters toward shallow cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier runs through soft sand toward dunes.
scenes.imageDescription: Windblown dunes, running British soldiers, wet sandy uniforms, black-and-white film grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator runs behind the troops, not ahead of them. Heavy sand makes the camera bounce and tilt; one soldier nearly fills the frame before camera drops into cover. Audio: boots in sand, aircraft, breath, surf.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera lies low behind same dune as lead soldier.

scenes.title: Sand Burst
scenes.description: A nearby impact throws sand above the dune.
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches while sand showers over helmet and shoulders.
scenes.imageDescription: Shallow dune cover, sand blast, smoke, crouched British troops, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: The blast surprises the operator: violent jolt downward, frame briefly filled by sand and sleeve, momentary soft focus and muffled sound, then shaky recovery without standing up. Audio: blast, falling sand, ringing-like dullness, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Lens retains faint sand specks as attack passes.

scenes.title: Return to the Queue
scenes.description: The beach reorganizes after the aircraft pass.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman walks back brushing sand from his sleeve.
scenes.imageDescription: Same beach with more smoke, line reforming, lead soldier dustier, monochrome film.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman rises cautiously from dune and follows from behind; uneven sand makes slow sway, lens specks remain until a small accidental smear at edge. Audio: surf, wind, fading aircraft, distant blast.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator rejoins queue beside lead soldier.

scenes.title: Toward the Mole
scenes.description: A section of the queue is directed toward the pier.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier joins a compact line walking toward the mole.
scenes.imageDescription: Long mole into grey water, soldiers in file, spray and smoke, period gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator walks inside the line, shoulder-to-shoulder, unable to see around everyone. Camera alternates between backs, boots and brief glimpses of the mole ahead. Wind and spray move the frame. Audio: surf, boards, boots, engines.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera reaches wet start of mole behind lead soldier.

scenes.title: Long Walk Above the Sea
scenes.description: The line advances along the exposed mole.
scenes.actionDescription: He walks with water visible on both sides.
scenes.imageDescription: Crowded narrow pier, grey sea, smoke, same soldier mid-line, archival monochrome.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman walks on wet boards behind the queue, slight side-to-side balance corrections from wind. Bodies block most long views; camera never floats over heads. Audio: boards, sea, gear, wind.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator remains mid-queue on exposed pier.

scenes.title: Boat Emerging Through Haze
scenes.description: A rescue craft appears beside the pier.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier looks toward the approaching craft.
scenes.imageDescription: Rescue boat through haze beside crowded mole, smoke beyond beach.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator notices soldiers turning before he sees boat, then pans late through shoulders toward craft. Wind pushes camera slightly off target; one railing post cuts frame. Audio: engine, waves, wind.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera returns to queue as craft settles near pier.

scenes.title: Attack on the Pier
scenes.description: Aircraft threat returns before boarding finishes.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman drops flat and grips wet boards.
scenes.imageDescription: Crowded pier under air attack pressure, water below, smoke, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator dives down with everyone, camera hitting board level and briefly skewing. Boots and coats block sight; one quick unsafe sky glance then immediate return to boards. Audio: aircraft, distant blast, boards creak, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains prone beside lead soldier.

scenes.title: Boarding
scenes.description: The line moves again and reaches the rescue craft.
scenes.actionDescription: He steps down from pier into the moving boat.
scenes.imageDescription: Wet boots, pier edge, packed rescue craft, same gear and uniform.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman boards immediately behind him with one hand implied on support. Frame tilts down to the dangerous step, jolts as boat shifts, then rises among packed bodies. Audio: hull knock, engine, water, gear.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera is now physically inside the same rescue craft.

scenes.title: Looking Back
scenes.description: From the boat the soldier sees the beach still full of troops.
scenes.actionDescription: He turns at the rail toward shore.
scenes.imageDescription: Sea-level view toward crowded beach, smoke inland, soldier foreground profile.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator squeezes between bodies to the rail, camera bumped twice by shoulders, then turns toward shore with boat sway. Horizon rocks naturally. Audio: engine, waves, wind, distant battle.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera holds beach through moving boat rail.

scenes.title: No Celebration
scenes.description: Rescued men sit packed together, soaked and exhausted.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman lowers his head and grips a wet rail.
scenes.imageDescription: Tired British soldiers packed on craft, wet helmets, no cheering, monochrome grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stays seated or crouched among them; near bodies dominate foreground and boat motion gently rocks composition. No staged close-up—only a small natural turn toward lead soldier. Audio: engine throb, water, slow breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains low among seated troops.

scenes.title: Beach Receding
scenes.description: Dunkirk shrinks behind the boat while smoke rises.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stays at the side as shoreline recedes.
scenes.imageDescription: Boat moving through grey sea, distant smoky beach, same soldier at rail.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator braces against rail; camera sways with boat and wind, periodically blocked by rigging. Rear-facing human-held view, no stabilized horizon. Audio: engine, sea, wind, battle fading.

scenes.title: Across the Grey Water
scenes.description: Several small craft move away beneath overcast sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The lead soldier becomes one figure among many aboard the craft.
scenes.imageDescription: Evacuation boats crossing grey sea, distant smoke, no triumphal imagery, archival monochrome.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera operator stands only as high as the boat safely allows, holding a long rear view with natural sway and occasional shoulder intrusion. No crane or aerial view. Audio: engine wash, waves, wind only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame drifts with boat as Dunkirk fades in distance.
